intro: Billet pairs softness with structure — a modern silhouette in a bold tone that feels warm, supportive, and quietly confident in any space you place it.

features.title: Sleek and minimalist design
features.text: Our design offers a neutral tone that complements wood, metal, or marble—effortlessly fitting into any setting.

features.title: Lean into quiet comfort
features.text: The slender, softly angled backrest supports your posture naturally—ideal for long dinners and easy mornings.

features.title: A form shaped in one breath
features.text: The upholstered singleshell plywood seat creates a sculptural, seamless silhouette — smooth to the eye, sturdy to the core.

features.title: Foundation that stays grounded
features.text: Matte black ink powder-coated legs add quiet strength and modern elegance — designed for durability without visual bulk.

features.title: Versatile by intention
features.text: From modern kitchens to layered dining rooms, Billet adapts with ease — blending in softly or standing out subtly, just the way you style it.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
